rule: A reserved trigger fires only when the complete trimmed user message equals one registered trigger word. Never trigger on ordinary prose containing the word.
mesh_rule: All scientific trigger branches are interdependent research views of one RAE. Every run must ingest all connected branches before Fusion 1, including newer in-progress branch material, preserve evidence ancestry, scan contradictions and write cross-links back to affected branches.

dump.purpose: Ingest arbitrary dump material, fuse it with current RAE knowledge, research derived hypotheses, packetize results, then archive the processed originals.

clay.purpose: Run the complete Synthetic Clay recursive research foundry across GWT, FRANK architecture, emergence measurement, ClayCode/4B internal language, hyperposition/codependency and low-latency emergent software.

gwt.purpose: Research Global Workspace mechanisms in AI systems: selection, competition, ignition, broadcast, reconstruction, effect, re-entry, multi-timescale coupling and causal validation.

frank.purpose: Research FRANK as one integrated cognitive/runtime architecture grounded primarily in newest Synthetic Clay research and authored as ClayCode semantic IR.

emergenz.purpose: Research and measure emergence using GWT-linked causal interventions, lesion/rescue, re-entry, interaction terms, PID/PEID/transfer entropy and multiscale causal tests.

claycode.purpose: Research ClayCode as the internal language/IR that represents the Clay system in which it runs, including a Clay-written runtime and Qwen-4B simulation/internalization.

hyperposition.purpose: Research emergent systems, contextual hyperposition, higher-order codependencies, dynamic topology and near-zero-latency software via shared/incremental state. 'Entanglement' is an engineering analogy unless physical quantum effects are actually tested.
